Package it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.service

Class LowLoadManager

java.lang.Object
it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.service.LowLoadManager
@Service public class LowLoadManager extends Object
Service for managing and executing background tasks when the CPU load is low. It utilizes a thread-safe queue to hold tasks and periodically checks the CPU load before processing them to ensure main application performance is not impacted.
